title: Output of the plan-h3 agent: the draft of one plan

dureeSecondes.description: Generation duration, whole seconds. Dialogue plan: expected duration of the lines plus a breathing margin of at least 2 s, rounded up. It is extended later if the real voice requires it.

references.description: The plan's reference assets, in the wanted order: characters, extras, props and effects, then set. Limits checked by the code: 6 image references at most, and 3 audio slots shared with the voices (the voice wins); `maxItems` is only the outer bound. The code assigns the labels (<Subject N>, <Picture N>, <Audio N>): never write one.

asset.description: Code of an existing registry asset (CHAR_maya, DEC_couloir_bois, SFX_porte…). Never an invented code, except a missing IMAGE asset that is also declared in `assetsManquants` with this exact same code.

nature.description: image: the asset is cited by its image (character, set, prop, effect). son: sound effect (SFX_… code) cited as an audio reference.

role.description: (French) Role in the plan, for the sheet (« Décor, couloir bleu nuit »).

nom.description: (English) How the sheet names the asset, no mandatory definite article: « Maya », « the Tenancière », « the narrow wooden corridor ».

definition.description: (English) The visible traits to follow (registry description: clothes, colours, materials, marks) then a static state in THIS plan (no action verb: the action goes in the shots), without « is » and without a label: « in her deep-red dancer's costume with a gilded corset, ruby eyes, breathless and dishevelled ».

retention.description: Optional. Default: fully_preserved for an image, reference for a sound. An effect (VFX_…) is never fully_preserved: weak_reference (default, set by the code) or attribute_transfer.

retentionNote.description: (English) Optional. What is kept or changed, and what the reference does not own (for an effect: no framing or composition).

summary.description: (English) One paragraph, WITHOUT a bracketed prefix (the code adds it). Assets are written [[CODE_ASSET]].

ouverture.description: (English) One to three sentences before the first shot: the light (the code puts the project's style clause first: write no visual style) and, when two or more characters act together, which one is on the left of the frame and which on the right, facing which way. No [[CODE]] marker.

shots.description: The shots in order. The code adds [Shot N], the timecode and « Hard cut to »: write no number, no timecode, no « Hard cut ».

debutSecondes.description: Entry time of the shot, in seconds from the start of the plan. 0 for the first shot. Aim for at least 1.5 s per shot (shorter only for a deliberate effect, stated in notes).

texte.description: (English) The shot. First shot: a complete sentence. Next shots: completes « Hard cut to », so start with the framing (« a low-angle shot of… »). Assets are written [[CODE_ASSET]]; dialogue in <d>[Français] …</d>, verbatim, with a speaker (S1).

overall_soundscape.description: (English) The background sound over the whole video (ambience, distant noises, crowd), without the heading « overall_soundscape: ». Sounds tied to an action are written in the shot text. May cite a sound effect as [[SFX_…]].

non_diegetic_music.description: (English) The music only the audience hears, by instrumentation, tempo and dynamics, without the heading « non_diegetic_music: ». Exactly « N/A » when there is none.

assetsManquants.description: Assets that should be created and that the registry does not contain. Empty if none is missing. A missing IMAGE asset is also cited in `references` (same code) and as [[CODE]] in the shots: it is created with the plan. A missing sound is described in prose.

code.description: Proposed code, prefixed by the type (PROP_lettre, DEC_ruelle_nuit).

parent.description: ALWAYS answer: the code of the BASE subject (from the registry) when this missing asset is a STATE of it (the same set with the fire out or at night, the same character wounded or transformed, the same prop broken): same type as that subject. `null` only for an independent asset. A state of a state also points to the base subject. For a `keyframe`, `null` and list the elements to combine in `raison`.

description.description: (French) What it is, as in the registry.

raison.description: (French) Why an existing reference is not enough.

notes.description: (French) Trade-offs, deliberate continuous gesture, deviations: a few short sentences at most. Empty if nothing to report. Never think aloud, never list options, never repeat a sentence.
